title: one SourceBuffer, different codec and container

definition.title: one SourceBuffer, different codec and container
definition.source_excerpt: A single SourceBuffer began as video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001e", buffered H.264/fMP4 through ~1.067 s, then called changeType() to VP9/WebM, set timestampOffset=1, and appended WebM initialization/media bytes. The final buffered range was 0.066666–4.000 s, with no exception or video error. This is more than codec switching: the parser also crossed ISO BMFF → WebM inside one MSE presentation.
